features.requirement: Import third-party academic skills as untrusted declarative procedures

features.requirement: Concurrent four-source metadata discovery and Unpaywall resolution

features.requirement: OA-only downloads, SSRF/redirect checks, signatures, size/hash dedup, backoff

features.requirement: Editable source priority, enable/disable, quotas, truthful availability

features.requirement: Versioned source-declared citation graph and unresolved external targets
features.remaining: Only known source references, not a complete citation graph. Out-of-Topic identifiers never reveal other Topic paper IDs.

features.requirement: External knowledge, observations, interpretations and approved decisions remain separate
Durable ingestion jobs, independent parse retry, per-Topic/domain quotas, cancellation/recovery

features.requirement: No-AI search, source/year/venue/type/PDF/tier/tag/flag filters, citation sorting, paging and bulk actions

Whitelisted plugin UI actions, disabled-plugin graceful fallback, feature flags and accessible layout

features.requirement: Stable writes, hashed versions, checkpoints, tombstones, offline recovery and transparency

features.requirement: Manual JSON mission preview, AI draft only on request, exact digest approval, retry/audit
